name: Starr Hill Pathways
org: UVA Karsh Institute Community Partnerships (University of Virginia)
what_you_do: A free path to college and a career. High school students get paid internships, college and career advice, SAT prep, tutoring and mentors.
who_can_apply: Youth who live in Charlottesville City or Albemarle County. You can be in grade 7 up to high school graduation.
pay_detail: Paid internship placements for high schoolers. Pay rate and hours are not stated on the page. The program itself is free, with transport and meals provided.
duration: Ongoing; summer camps for younger students and internships for high schoolers
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Send one form for each student on the program Application and Wait List page. Contact partnerships@virginia.edu or 434-924-2414.
notes: Pay and internship details are not posted. Ask the office. There is a wait list.
